# AudioToolbox

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 17.8% of Apple's iOS API (538 of 3023, exact) · **Rows:** 78% (9: 7 ✅ 2 ❌) · **iOS:** 2.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [AudioToolbox](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/audiotoolbox) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted, Swift-only:** isim's own Audio Units, AUGraph and queues on the mixer; codecs through the host's libavcodec. There are no C headers yet.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| AudioToolbox System Sound Services (`AudioServicesCreateSystemSoundID`, `PlaySystemSound`, completions) | ✅ | ≤17 | sounds from files play; built-in IDs are synthesized (adapted: Apple's recordings are not shipped): dial-pad DTMF tones at their standard frequencies, the camera shutter, clicks, chimes; tested (HelloAudio) |
| `kSystemSoundID_Vibrate`, `AudioServicesPlayAlertSound` vibration | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted (no vibration motor, like the Simulator): logged (`isim: haptic vibrate`) and shown as a large ring like UIKit's feedback generators; peek / pop / nope IDs vibrate too; tested (HelloAudio) |
| Audio File Services (`AudioFileOpenURL`, `AudioFileCreateWithURL`, properties, read/write bytes and packets) | ✅ | ≤17 | PCM WAV/AIFF/CAF read and written directly; compressed files are decoded by the host (then presented as 48 kHz float, adapted); tested |
| Extended Audio File Services (`ExtAudioFile*`: client format, read, write, seek) | ✅ | ≤17 | client-format conversion (sample type, channels, rate); compressed file types are written as PCM and encoded by ffmpeg on dispose (unverified); tested: WAV → 48 kHz mono float, CAF write |
| Audio Converter Services (`AudioConverterNew`, `ConvertBuffer`, `FillComplexBuffer`, `ConvertComplexBuffer`, properties) | ✅ | ≤17 | linear PCM ↔ linear PCM (format, channels, resampling with a band-limited resampler, prime info); AAC encoding and AAC / MP3 decoding through the host's libavcodec (magic cookies, bit rate, maximum packet size; ADTS / ESDS); other codecs return `kAudioConverterErr_FormatNotSupported`; tested (HelloMedia: PCM conversion, AAC round trip) |
| Audio Queue Services (output and input queues, buffers, start/pause/stop, volume, rate, pitch, pan, current time, level metering, processing taps, `IsRunning` listener) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: output pulled by the host mixer in real time (silently when headless) with isim's time-pitch and pan; input from the simulated microphone; processing taps; tested (HelloAudio: callbacks, time, input peak; HelloAudioEngine: rate and pitch seen by a processing tap, pan in the mixer output) |
| Audio Units (`AudioComponent`, `AudioUnit` properties / parameters / render callbacks, Remote IO, `AUGraph`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim's units — Remote IO and Voice Processing IO (output and input), generic output, multichannel mixer (volume, pan, metering), AUConverter, varispeed, time-pitch, delay, reverb, N-band / parametric EQ, low / high / band pass and shelf filters, distortion, peak limiter; render callbacks and notifications, `AudioUnitRender` pull, property listeners; AUGraph nodes, connections and callbacks; no third-party Audio Unit extensions (AUv3); tested (HelloAudioEngine: an AUGraph callback → mixer → Remote IO with render notify, the Remote IO input bus, generic output pulling AUConverter, AudioUnitProcess with the delay) |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `AU3DMixerAttenuationCurve`, `AU3DMixerRenderingFlags`, `AUAudioMixRenderingStyle`, `AUAudioUnit`, `AUAudioUnitBus`, `AUAudioUnitBusArray`, `AUAudioUnitBusType`, `AUAudioUnitFactory`, `AUAudioUnitPreset`, `AUAudioUnitV2Bridge`, `AUChannelInfo`, `AUDependentParameter`, `AudioBalanceFade`, `AudioBalanceFadeType`, `AudioBytePacketTranslation`, `AudioBytePacketTranslationFlags`, `AudioCodecMagicCookieInfo`, `AudioCodecPrimeInfo`, `AudioComponentFlags`, `AudioComponentPlugInInterface`, `AudioComponentValidationResult`, `AudioConverterOptions`, `AudioFile_SMPTE_Time`, `AudioFileMarker`, `AudioFileMarkerList`, `AudioFilePacketTableInfo`, `AudioFileRegion`, `AudioFileRegionFlags`, `AudioFileRegionList`, `AudioFileStreamParseFlags`, `AudioFileStreamPropertyFlags`, `AudioFileStreamSeekFlags`, `AudioFileTypeAndFormatID`, `AudioFormatInfo`, `AudioFramePacketTranslation`, `AudioIndependentPacketTranslation`, `AudioOutputUnitMIDICallbacks`, `AudioOutputUnitStartAtTimeParams`, `AudioPacketDependencyInfoTranslation`, `AudioPacketRangeByteCountTranslation`, `AudioPacketRollDistanceTranslation`, `AudioPanningInfo`, `AudioPanningMode`, `AudioQueueChannelAssignment`, `AudioQueueParameterEvent`, `AudioSettingsFlags`, `AudioUnitEvent`, `AudioUnitEventType`, `AudioUnitExternalBuffer`, `AudioUnitFrequencyResponseBin`, `AudioUnitMeterClipping`, `AudioUnitNodeConnection`, `AudioUnitParameterEvent`, `AudioUnitParameterHistoryInfo`, `AudioUnitParameterInfo`, `AudioUnitParameterNameInfo`, `AudioUnitParameterOptions`, `AudioUnitParameterStringFromValue`, `AudioUnitParameterUnit`, `AudioUnitParameterValueFromString` and 79 more (139 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
